lines.text: Hallelujah! When the King speaks the word, it cannot be overturned. It's as good as done. And when heaven touches earth, it can never be reversed. It's the kingdom come. So get the liars out the way.
lines.text_sk: Aleluja! Keď Kráľ prehovorí slovo, nemožno ho odvolať. Je to hotová vec. A keď sa nebo dotkne zeme, nedá sa to zvrátiť. Je to príchod kráľovstva. Tak odstráňte klamárov z cesty.

lines.text: They don't have the final say.
There is only one, sovereign and supreme. Every word he speaks is holy. The Lamb of God has overcome. My testimony is his blood. And if he said that it is done, it is done. So be it, God.
lines.text_sk: Existuje iba jeden, zvrchovaný a najvyšší. Každé slovo, ktoré hovorí, je sväté. Baránok Boží zvíťazil. Moje svedectvo je jeho krv. A ak povedal, že je to dokonané, je to dokonané. Staň sa, Bože.

lines.text: To the one on the throne who cannot be overcome, sing hallelujah. To the last and the first ruler of the universe, sing hallelujah! To the Alpha Omega, the Master, the Maker, the Name above every other name, give him all the praise, he's holy! The Lamb of God has overcome! My testimony is his word, and if he said that it is done, it is done. So be it, God. The weapons of the enemy—they have no power over me. The one with all authority covers me. So be it, God. So be glad, so be glad.
lines.text_sk: Tomu, ktorý sedí na tróne a nedá sa prekonať, spievajte aleluja. Poslednému a prvému vládcovi vesmíru, spievajte aleluja! Alfa a Omega, Pán, Stvoriteľ, Meno nad každé iné meno, jemu vzdávajte všetku chválu, je svätý! Baránok Boží zvíťazil! Moje svedectvo je jeho slovo, a ak povedal, že je to hotové, je to hotové. Nech sa tak stane, Bože. Zbrane nepriateľa – nemajú nado mnou moc. Ten, ktorý má všetku autoritu, ma pokrýva. Nech sa tak stane, Bože. Tak sa radujte, tak sa radujte.

lines.text: From a throne to a cross, who would pay such a price for the sins of the world? Here's your King. Crucified, see the nails in his hands, see the wounds in his side, see the crown meant to mock that instead prophesied that it was not the end.
lines.text_sk: Z trónu na kríž, kto by zaplatil takú cenu za hriechy sveta? Tu je váš Kráľ. Ukrižovaný, pozrite na klince v jeho rukách, pozrite na rany v jeho boku, pozrite na korunu, ktorá mala vysmievať, ale namiesto toho prorokovala, že to nebol koniec.

lines.text: Wipe the tears from your eyes, don't forget That He said, on the third He will rise. He's alive! He's alive! He's alive! He's alive! He's alive! He's alive! He's alive!
lines.text_sk: Utri si slzy z očí, nezabudni, že povedal, na tretí deň vstane. Je živý! Je živý! Je živý! Je živý! Je živý! Je živý! Je živý!

lines.text: The Lamb of God has overcome. My testimony is His word. And if he said that it is done, it is done. So be it, God. The weapons of the enemy, they have no power over me. The word with all authority covers me. So be it, God. So be it, God. It is final, it is written, it is settled, it is finished. See that old grave, he was in it, now he isn't. He is risen. It is final, it is written, it is settled, it is finished. See that old grave, he was in it, now he isn't. He is risen. Hallelujah. Hallelujah! Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
lines.text_sk: Baránok Boží zvíťazil. Moje svedectvo je Jeho slovo. A ak povedal, že je to dokonané, je to dokonané. Nech sa tak stane, Bože. Zbrane nepriateľa nemajú nado mnou moc. Slovo s plnou autoritou ma pokrýva. Nech sa tak stane, Bože. Nech sa tak stane, Bože. Je to konečné, je to napísané, je to rozhodnuté, je to dokonané. Pozrite na ten starý hrob, bol v ňom, teraz už nie je. Vstal z mŕtvych. Je to konečné, je to napísané, je to rozhodnuté, je to dokonané. Pozrite na ten starý hrob, bol v ňom, teraz už nie je. Vstal z mŕtvych. Aleluja. Aleluja! Aleluja! Aleluja!

lines.text: Hallelujah! Hallelujah! Hallelujah! Oh! Oh! Hallelujah!
lines.text_sk: Aleluja! Aleluja! Aleluja! Ó! Ó! Aleluja!

lines.text: Like a thief in the night, he'll return. For his bride.
lines.text_sk: Ako zlodej v noci sa vráti. Pre svoju nevestu.

lines.text: Split the skies. So be it, God.
lines.text_sk: Rozdeľte nebesá. Nech sa tak stane, Bože.
